title: Softness is something you also need! Why compliance helps control: information metrics of a passive walker with compliant ankle
abstract: arXiv:2611.13779v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A great gap in adaptivity, flexibility, and dexterity still exists between intelligent robots, whether they are made of rigid or (partially) compliant components, and their naturally evolved animal and vegetal counterparts. One reason could be of `paradigm' nature. On the one hand, most robots (both rigid and soft) are still designed by following a `Cartesian' approach, with top-down control and a clear mind-body separation. Designing artificial agents on the basis of the principles that we observe in biology is not an easy task. The principles of organization of animals and plants rely on morphological computation and emergence of fit behaviors from loosely coupled networks of embodied agents.   Modeling and control require radically new approaches. translated_title: 柔软也是你所需要的！为什么柔顺性有助于控制：具有柔性踝关节的被动行走器的信息度量
translated_abstract: 无论是完全刚性还是（部分）柔性组件构成的智能机器人，与自然进化的动植物对应物之间，在适应性、灵活性和灵巧性方面仍然存在巨大差距。其中一个原因可能是“范式”层面的。一方面，大多数机器人（无论刚性还是软体）仍然遵循“笛卡尔式”方法进行设计，即采用自上而下的控制和清晰的身心分离。基于我们在生物学中观察到的原理来设计人工智能体并非易事——动物和植物的组织原则依赖于形态计算，以及从松耦合的具身智能体网络中涌现出的适配行为。建模与控制需要全新的方法。在本文中，我们简要回顾并解释了一些多年前发表的开创性数学成果，这些成果将信息度量与智能体动力学联系起来；我们将其与……
tldr: 本文通过回顾信息度量与智能体动力学之间的数学联系，并应用于带柔性踝关节的被动行走器，揭示了柔顺性有助于控制的机理，从而倡导超越笛卡尔式身心分离、基于形态计算与涌现的机器人设计新范式。
en_tdlr: By revisiting seminal mathematical results linking information metrics to agent dynamics and applying them to a passive walker with a compliant ankle, this paper reveals why compliance aids control and advocates a robot design paradigm based on morphological computation and emergence beyond the Cartesian mind-body separation.
